gloss: to frown, to knit one's brows

definitions.gloss: to frown, to knit one's brows
definitions.explanation: To draw the eyebrows together in an expression of displeasure, concern, or disapproval.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{発言|はつげん}に{眉|まゆ}をひそめた。
{眉|まゆ}をひそめるような{行為|こうい}は{控|ひか}えてください。
examples.english: Please refrain from behavior that would make people frown.

examples.japanese: {報告|ほうこく}を{聞|き}いて{課長|かちょう}は{眉|まゆ}をひそめた。
examples.english: The section chief frowned upon hearing the report.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}の{中|なか}で{大声|おおごえ}で{話|はな}す{人|ひと}に、{周|まわ}りの{乗客|じょうきゃく}は{眉|まゆ}をひそめた。
examples.english: The other passengers frowned at the person talking loudly on the train.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{無礼|ぶれい}な{態度|たいど}に、{先輩|せんぱい}たちはみな{眉|まゆ}をひそめた。{本人|ほんにん}だけが{気|き}づいていなかった。
examples.english: The senior colleagues all frowned at his rude behavior. He was the only one who didn't notice.

notes:
STRUCTURE: {眉|まゆ} (eyebrow) + を + ひそめる (to draw together, contract)

NUANCE: Expresses silent disapproval or concern. Often used to describe a reaction to something improper, worrying, or distasteful. More subtle than openly criticizing.

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- {眉|まゆ}を{上|あ}げる (to raise eyebrows - surprise)
- しかめっ{面|つら}をする (to make a sour face)
- {顔|かお}をしかめる (to grimace)

OTHER {眉|まゆ} EXPRESSIONS:
- {眉|まゆ}をひそめる: displeasure, concern
- {眉|まゆ}を{上|あ}げる: surprise
- {眉|まゆ}を{寄|よ}せる: to furrow brows (similar to ひそめる)

FORMALITY: Slightly literary/formal expression, often seen in written descriptions.
